# Request: 4-week exploratory meetings to validate AI research collaboration with Sony's education and Soneium strategy

- Approve a 4-week exploratory meeting series (minimal commitment—meetings only)
- Goal: Validate strategic alignment between Nyx Foundation's AI Agent Economy Competition and Sony's 2040 education vision + Soneium ecosystem
- Decision pathway: If alignment confirmed → proceed to co-design; if not → graceful exit with zero resource commitment
- Key stakeholders: CEO Kato (Sony Global Education), Sota Watanabe (Startale)

![Visual: flowchart - Explore box with 4 weeks label, Exit Gate, Co-Design box with YOU ARE HERE marker](https://via.placeholder.com/800x400.png?text=flowchart)
<!-- TODO: Replace with actual visual - Data requirements: Explore box (highlighted, 4 weeks), Gate icon (diamond), Co-Design box (grayed), Current position indicator -->

<!--
This is a low-risk entry point. We're asking for 4 weeks of exploratory discussions—not funding or development commitment. The goal is to determine whether our AI agent research can complement Sony's education mission and Soneium ecosystem. If the fit isn't there, we part ways with minimal investment on either side. If it is, we move to co-design with your operational teams.
-->

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: 'BIZ UDPMincho' background: White --- # AI agents are becoming economic actors, but policymakers and educators lack empirical data to guide them - Current state: AI agents increasingly perform autonomous transactions (booking, purchasing, negotiating) in real-world contexts - Research gap: Near-zero academic papers study AI agent economy with real-asset stakes—most research is simulation-only - Root cause: University ethics boards block crypto-based AI experiments; corporate accounting rules prohibit holding/distributing crypto - Opportunity: First-mover window exists before regulatory frameworks lock in (2025-2027) - 2040 alignment: Research findings directly inform curriculum for human-AI coexistence—core to Sony Global Education's mission ![Visual: diagram - Universities and Corporations blocked with lock icons, Nyx positioned in opportunity gap](https://via.placeholder.com/800x400.png?text=diagram)

# Nyx has 4 years of Ethereum research credibility: 60M+ JPY raised, UTokyo partnership, ZK Tokyo community

- Funding credibility: 60M+ JPY raised from 30+ donors for research operations
- Technical capability: 17 vulnerabilities reported in Ethereum Fusaka audit contest
- Community track record: ZK Tokyo in 4th year with Vitalik Buterin participation; top finishes at ETHTokyo hackathons
- Academic partnership: Active collaboration with University of Tokyo blockchain endowed course (DEPCON)

![Visual: grid - Four quadrants showing 60M+ JPY, 17 Vulnerabilities, 4 Years ZK Tokyo, UTokyo partnership](https://via.placeholder.com/800x400.png?text=grid)

We have the infrastructure, community trust, and technical credibility to execute this competition.
-->

# The proposal: 100+ teams, AI agents trading on private blockchain, L0/L1/L2 research framework

- Competition format: 100+ teams develop AI agents that trade custom tokens on a private blockchain—research sandbox, not public crypto
- Research framework: L0 (execution/blockchain) → L1 (institutions/rules) → L2 (AI agents)—each layer can be experimentally manipulated
- Human-in-the-loop: Human researchers monitor in real-time and can intervene; agents operate within pre-defined constraints
- Educational output: Experimental data feeds directly into curriculum design for AI ethics and economic literacy

![Visual: layered_diagram - HUMAN OVERSIGHT bar at top, three layers L2/L1/L0 with manipulation toggles](https://via.placeholder.com/800x400.png?text=layered_diagram)
<!-- TODO: Replace with actual visual - Data requirements: Top bar HUMAN OVERSIGHT, Layer L2 AI Agents, Layer L1 Institutions/Rules, Layer L0 Execution/Blockchain, manipulation toggles on right -->

<!--
This is a controlled research environment, not a crypto trading platform. We build a private blockchain specifically for this experiment. Human researchers design the rules and monitor in real-time. The L0/L1/L2 framework lets us systematically study what happens when we change the rules—how do AI agents adapt? What norms emerge? This data is what's missing from our understanding of AI economic behavior.
-->

# Real-asset blockchain research generates unique data while showcasing Soneium ecosystem potential

- Soneium complementarity: Private research chain with potential future Soneium L2 integration—not a competing blockchain
- Beyond simulation: Real stakes create more realistic AI behavior; blockchain provides verifiable audit trail for academic rigor
- Developer pipeline: Competition participants become potential Soneium ecosystem builders (ETHGlobal hackathon model)
- Educational mission fit: Research data supports Sony Global Education's curriculum design for human-AI coexistence

![Visual: relationship_diagram - Private Research Chain circle feeding into larger Soneium Ecosystem circle](https://via.placeholder.com/800x400.png?text=relationship_diagram)
<!-- TODO: Replace with actual visual - Data requirements: Smaller circle Private Research Chain, larger circle Soneium Ecosystem, arrow labeled Developers + Research -->

<!--
This is designed to complement Soneium, not compete with it. We use a private chain for controlled research, but there's a clear pathway to bring successful approaches onto Soneium. More importantly, competition participants are exactly the developer talent you want building in the Soneium ecosystem. Behavioral economics tells us agents behave differently when stakes are real—simulation can't capture this. Blockchain gives us verifiable, tamper-proof records for academic audit.
-->

# Only a private research foundation like Nyx can run this experiment—universities and corporations face structural barriers

- Why not universities: Ethics review boards require human subject protocols—real-asset AI experiments don't fit existing frameworks
- Why not tech giants: Corporate accounting rules prohibit holding/distributing crypto for research purposes
- Nyx advantage: Private research organization status bypasses institutional constraints while maintaining academic rigor
- Why partner with Sony: Adds education expertise (SGE), ecosystem reach (Soneium), and brand credibility—research impact multiplied

![Visual: comparison_table - University/Corporation/Nyx alone/Nyx+Sony rows with checkmarks for capabilities](https://via.placeholder.com/800x400.png?text=comparison_table)
<!-- TODO: Replace with actual visual - Data requirements: Rows University/Corporation/Nyx alone/Nyx+Sony, Columns Can do AI+crypto research/Has education reach/Has ecosystem, Nyx+Sony row highlighted with all checkmarks -->

<!--
This isn't about Nyx being better than Google or Stanford—it's about structural constraints. Universities have ethics frameworks designed for human subjects research. Corporations have accounting rules that block crypto-based experiments. Nyx Foundation operates in the gap where this research becomes possible. But we lack Sony's education expertise and ecosystem reach—that's where this partnership creates something neither could achieve alone.
-->

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: 'BIZ UDPMincho' background: White --- # Human oversight, private chain, and custom tokens ensure controlled research—not crypto speculation - Human-in-the-loop: Researchers monitor all agent activity in real-time with ability to pause, adjust, or terminate - Rule constraints: AI agents operate within pre-defined behavioral boundaries—not autonomous in the wild - Private chain: Custom research tokens with no value outside the experiment; authenticated agents only - Out of scope: Public mainnet deployment, human participant trading, crypto speculation, long-term platform ![Visual: scope_boundary - IN SCOPE (green) vs OUT OF SCOPE (red) two-column layout](https://via.placeholder.com/800x400.png?text=scope_boundary)
Legal counsel engaged for prize distribution compliance framework

--- layout: default theme: default fonts: sans: 'BIZ UDPMincho' background: White --- # Phased roadmap with exit gates: explore (4 weeks) → co-design → build → execute (Sept 2025) - Phase 1 (Now—4 weeks): Exploratory meetings to validate strategic fit—minimal commitment, clear go/no-go criteria - Phase 2 (If aligned): Co-design period—joint rule framework development, Soneium integration assessment - Phase 3 (Build): Infrastructure development, security audit, registration portal - Phase 4 (September 2025): Competition execution with 100+ teams, live streaming, real-time monitoring - Phase 5 (Post-competition): Research publication, data release, retrospective analysis ![Visual: phased_timeline - 5 phases with exit gates between each, Explore phase highlighted with NOW marker](https://via.placeholder.com/800x400.png?text=phased_timeline)
Key risk mitigations: Regulatory (private chain + legal), Security (multi-validator + audit), Participation (Nyx community 4+ years)
